universe.kind: point-in-time S&P 500 members + 93 index funds + 73 Canadian companies

note: Point-in-time replay: decisions use data up to each day's close, fills at the next open. Stocks are chosen only from what was in the S&P 500 that day (plus index funds and a Canadian list made today); companies Yahoo has no prices for (mostly delisted) cannot be chosen, a survivorship bias that remains. Not financial advice.
